studies.Study: Deckers IA et al. (2014) [PMID: 24327014] — estimate 1 · NA
studies.Reference: Long-term dietary sodium, potassium and fluid intake; exploring potential novel risk factors for renal cell cancer in the Netherlands Cohort Study on diet and cancer.
studies.Title: Long-term dietary sodium, potassium and fluid intake; exploring potential novel risk factors for renal cell cancer in the Netherlands Cohort Study on diet and cancer.
studies.Authors: Deckers IA, van den Brandt PA, van Engeland M, Soetekouw PM, Baldewijns MM, Goldbohm RA, Schouten LJ

sample_size.excerpt: The Netherlands Cohort Study (NLCS) with case-cohort design included 120 852 participants aged 55–69 years.

cases.excerpt: After 17.3 years of follow-up, 485 RCC cases and 4438 subcohort members were available for analyses.

design.excerpt: The present study is conducted within the Netherlands Cohort Study (NLCS), a prospective cohort study including 120 852 participants aged 55–69 years at baseline

timing.excerpt: All cohort members were followed up for cancer occurrence, whereas the subcohort was followed up for vital status to estimate person years at risk for the entire cohort.

continent.excerpt: Intakes of sodium, potassium and fluid were calculated using the computerised Dutch food composition table

ethnicity.excerpt: The present study is conducted within the Netherlands Cohort Study (NLCS), a prospective cohort study including 120 852 participants aged 55–69 years at baseline

exposure_measurement.excerpt: In brief, a 150-item, food frequency questionnaire (FFQ) represented the dietary part of the questionnaire ( Goldbohm et al , 1994 , 1995 ). Intakes of sodium, potassium and fluid were calculated using the computerised Dutch food composition table
